//: Masters, modernised (2026-10-20): the six chapter paintings for scripts/art.py --config. The masters are local retouches, not on the CDN: they live in .art/masters-2026-10-20/ (git-ignored, ~263 MB; SHA256SUMS beside them). Rebuild: python3 scripts/art.py --config scripts/art-masters.json --depth /home/user/models/midas_small.onnx (writes public/assets/scenes/<chapter>/ and merges index.json), then python3 scripts/depth-directors.py (Directors' depth is hand-layered). focus/phoneFocus: x, y from the top-left of each frame.

creators.note: Title zone moved up from the judge's mid-height box (0.06 0.22 0.46 0.56) to the pale sky band (0.04 0.04 0.46 0.28), because the Creators opener sets its title near the top: the sky band is calmer (luma sd 14 vs 34) and reads better with dark ink (worst decile 8.9:1 vs 3.9:1).
